import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

interface FormData {
  fullName: string;
  email: string;
  dob: string;
}

test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/policy-form');
});

test('submit valid form', async ({ page }) => {
  const today = new Date();
  const validDob = new Date(today.getFullYear() - 16, today.getMonth(), today.getDate());
  const validDobString = validDob.toISOString().split('T')[0];

  const data: FormData = {
    fullName: 'Jane Doe',
    email: 'jane.doe@example.com',
    dob: validDobString
  };

  await page.fill('input[name="fullName"]', data.fullName);
  await page.fill('input[name="email"]', data.email);
  await page.fill('input[name="dob"]', data.dob);
  await page.click('button[type="submit"]');

  await expect(page).toHaveURL('/success');
});

test('submit invalid form', async ({ page }) => {
  const today = new Date();
  const invalidDob = new Date(today.getFullYear() - 15, today.getMonth(), today.getDate());
  const invalidDobString = invalidDob.toISOString().split('T')[0];

  const invalidData: FormData = {
    fullName: '',
    email: 'invalid-email',
    dob: invalidDobString
  };

  await page.fill('input[name="fullName"]', invalidData.fullName);
  await page.fill('input[name="email"]', invalidData.email);
  await page.fill('input[name="dob"]', invalidData.dob);
  await page.click('button[type="submit"]');

  await expect(page.locator('input[name="fullName"]')).toHaveAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
  await expect(page.locator('input[name="email"]')).toHaveAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
  await expect(page.locator('input[name="dob"]')).toHaveAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');

  await expect(page.locator('div#error-fullName')).toContainText('Full name is required');
  await expect(page.locator('div#error-email')).toContainText('Valid email required');
  await expect(page.locator('div#error-dob')).toContainText('Must be at least 16 years old');
});
